verification.title: License verification
verification.optional_sub_tail: — you're already live in customer search. Verified stylists get a badge on their profile and tend to earn more bookings.
verification.perk_badge_desc: Shown on your profile, portfolio, and search results.
verification.perk_trust_desc: Customers filter for verified stylists in busy cities.
verification.submit_help: Paste a URL to a photo of your government-issued ID or braiding license.
verification.submit_help_legacy: Paste a URL to a photo of your government-issued ID or braiding license. Your profile will be locked until an admin approves.
verification.rejected_sub: Your last submission wasn't approved. Fix the issues below and resubmit — you'll go back into the queue with a fresh 3-day SLA.
verification.no_reason_given: No specific reason given. Please upload a clearer photo of a government-issued ID or braiding license.
verification.step1_desc: Understand what the admin flagged in your previous upload.
verification.step2_desc: Well-lit, no glare, full document visible, text readable.
verification.step3_desc: Paste the new URL below. Your profile stays hidden from customers until re-approved.
verification.upload_new_help: We've kept your previous URL so you can adjust it — replace with the new photo before resubmitting.
verification.same_url_hint: Change the URL before resubmitting — otherwise you'll upload the same document that was rejected.
verification.success_message: Admin has 3 business days to re-review. You'll get a notification with the outcome.
verification.pending_message: Under review — typically completed within 3 business days.
verification.pending_help: Your profile stays hidden from customer search while pending. We'll notify you as soon as an admin reviews.
verification.approved_message: You're verified. Your profile is live in customer search.

dashboard.no_appointments: No appointments today. Time to grow the business.
dashboard.ver_rejected_msg: Tap to see feedback and resubmit.
dashboard.ver_pending_msg: You're live either way. Result within 3 business days.
